topic: Investigating data spikes and formula changes
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing data spikes observed in City center traffic and impressions. It was noted that the traffic increase starting October 1st was expected due to a pre-announced factor change.

However, concerns were raised regarding an impression spike reported by the client (jcd), which allegedly increased from November 22nd. A key point of discussion was whether AllUnite had released any changes to the impressions formula or API data during this period, as the client bases its own impression calculation on AllUnite's data.

It was confirmed that a new city factor was released on November 1st, and multiple parties agreed to investigate potential underlying data changes.
decisions: The traffic spike starting October 1st is attributed to an expected factor change.
A thorough investigation is required to verify if any API or formula changes were made that could account for the impression spike observed from November 22nd.
action_items: Investigate potential changes to the API data and impressions formula during the specified period.
Schedule a data meeting with the client when the new model is ready, ensuring transparency regarding findings.
